metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 1963 · Suzanne's Career
metas.description: The friendship of Bertrand and Guillaume is complicated when the womanizing Guillaume begins to pursue a charming girl named Suzanne.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.3 · 1967 · The Collector
metas.description: A womanizing art dealer and a painter find the serenity of their Riviera vacation disturbed by a third guest, a vivacious bohemian woman known for her long list of male conquests.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.8 · 1969 · My Night at Maud's
metas.description: A devout Catholic man's rigid principles are challenged during a one-night stay with Maud, a divorced woman with an outsize personality.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.4 · 1970 · Claire's Knee
metas.description: On lakeside summer holiday, a conflicted older man is dared to have a flirt with two beautiful teenage half-sisters despite his betrothal to a diplomat's daughter and the fact that the girls have boyfriends.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.6 · 1972 · Love in the Afternoon
metas.description: Though he has an adoring wife, a bourgeois man is still tempted to pursue other women.
